Defects blocking level 3: TopBar.tsx:30 sets outline-none on the account DropdownMenuTrigger with no focus-visible replacement; ActiveUsersChart.tsx:77-89 uses role=tablist/tab on plain buttons without the APG keyboard model; LogSection.tsx:163-171 conveys platform only through an aria-hidden icon. Enforcement is absent: eslint-config-next ships only 6 jsx-a11y rules all at warn severity (node_modules/eslint-config-next/dist/index.js:173-188), no jsx-a11y config at error severity in apps/admin/eslint.config.mjs, and no axe or accessibility CI exists (rg -il 'axe|lighthouse|a11y|accessib' .github/workflows/ returns nothing; the only workflows are android*.yml, arkaik.yml, lab-note-reminder.yml). Matches l2: accessible primitives and keyboard-completable flows, but nothing checks for regressions.

Deliberate convention is visible and strong: zero div/span onClick hits across components and app (rg '<(div|span)[^>]*onClick' returned nothing); every outline-none is paired with focus-visible rings (30+ sites, e.g. components/path/PebbleCard.tsx:48); overlays are Base UI primitives with focus management including the hand-styled PebblePeek (components/path/PebblePeek.tsx:84 uses DialogPrimitive.Root); the valence fan is a full APG radiogroup with roving tabindex, arrow-key handlers, clamped movement, localized option names, and 44px hit targets (components/record/valence/ValenceFanPicker.tsx:108-176); week navigation has real buttons with aria-pressed (components/path/WeekRollCairn.tsx:18-26) so the swipe pager is an enhancement; a written WCAG section exists in docs/agents/ui-and-styling.md. Blocking l3: the a11y lint is only the six jsx-a11y rules bundled by eslint-config-next, five at warn severity (node_modules/eslint-config-next/dist/index.js; eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y not configured directly in apps/web/eslint.config.mjs); no axe or keyboard e2e run exists anywhere (no web CI workflow at all); no recorded manual keyboard or screen reader pass found in docs/superpowers (all a11y spec sections found are iOS ones); carve DrawingCanvas is pointer-only (components/carve/DrawingCanvas.tsx:96, role=img, path-input exception arguable but undocumented).

A token system encodes intended pairs (app/globals.css:4-37) and mechanically computed ratios (script over the oklch tokens) show most pass: foreground on background 19.9:1, muted-foreground on background 4.83:1, primary pairs 16.97:1. Measured failures exist with no measurement in place: RetentionHeatmap.tsx:14 bucket 4 renders text-stone-50 on bg-stone-400 at 2.41:1 for text-xs cell values; muted-foreground on muted computes 4.39:1 (hover state at TimeRangeTabs.tsx:34); chart series tokens chart-1 oklch(0.87 0 0) and chart-2 oklch(0.70 0 0) compute 1.48:1 and 2.68:1 against the white background, below the 3:1 non-text minimum, and are used as line strokes and bar fills (ActiveUsersChart.tsx:38-39, PebbleVolumeChart.tsx:35-36, BounceDistributionChart.tsx:17, DomainShare.tsx:37). Reflow posture is sound: no arbitrary fixed widths outside ui primitives (rg 'w-\[|min-w-\[' over app/components excluding ui returns nothing), tables sit in overflow-x-auto containers (components/ui/table.tsx:11, RetentionHeatmap.tsx:81), the sidebar collapses to a sheet under 768px (hooks/use-mobile.ts:3). No contrast script, no axe rule, no 320px viewport test exists anywhere in the workspace (apps/admin has no test script at all per baseline). Matches l2: at least one pair measurably fails AA and nothing measures.

A complete dark token block exists (app/globals.css:39-71 redefines every token from :root lines 4-37) but no mechanism ever applies it: no ThemeProvider is mounted (app/layout.tsx:11-19; rg 'next-themes' hits only components/ui/sonner.tsx:3), nothing sets the .dark class, and globals.css lacks the '@custom-variant dark' line that apps/web/app/globals.css:5 has. Consequence: Tailwind v4's default dark: variant compiles to the prefers-color-scheme media query, so under OS dark the component-level dark: utilities activate while the class-scoped tokens stay light, producing a mismatched hybrid: KpiCard.tsx:77-78 (and DomainShare.tsx:157-158, UserAverages.tsx:128-129, QualitySignalsTable.tsx:111-112) switch delta text to emerald-400/rose-400 on a still-light secondary badge (roughly 1.8:1), input.tsx renders dark:bg-input/30 translucent fields on the light page, and sonner's Toaster theme='system' shows dark toasts on the light app. Literal bypasses: LogSection.tsx:89-105 hardcoded hex platform colors, RetentionHeatmap.tsx:9-18 fixed stone-* palette, MarkdownField.tsx data-color-mode='light'. forced-colors is never handled (rg 'forced-colors|forced-color-adjust' over apps/admin returns nothing). Torn between 1 and 2: the token system has full parity on paper, but the switching machinery is broken so system theme changes are only partially picked up and produce failing pairs, which is the l1 anchor; scored the lower level per the discipline.

Zero occurrences of any reduce-motion API in the surface: rg 'prefers-reduced-motion|useReducedMotion|motion-reduce|motion-safe' over apps/admin app, components, lib, hooks returns nothing, and the imported animation library has no built-in gate (rg -l 'prefers-reduced-motion' node_modules/tw-animate-css/dist/ returns nothing). Animations that therefore run unconditionally: zoom/fade/slide enter-exit on dialog (components/ui/dialog.tsx:34,56), dropdown menus (dropdown-menu.tsx:44,138), select (select.tsx:86), tooltip (tooltip.tsx:53) and sheet; looping skeleton pulse (skeleton.tsx:7 animate-pulse); spinner (sonner.tsx:28 animate-spin); recharts mount animations with isAnimationActive never set (rg 'isAnimationActive' over components returns nothing). No Rive/Lottie on this surface and no motion runs past a few seconds outside loading states, which limits harm, but the l0 anchor is matched verbatim: no reduce-motion API anywhere, animations autoplay unconditionally.

Reduce-motion gating is deliberate but partial. The system animator scale is read and honored in the two loudest surfaces: WelcomeScreen.kt:283-291 gates the carousel auto-advance and reveal (WelcomeCarousel.kt:41-42) and ValenceFan.kt:206-216 gates the stone lift, both explicitly mirroring the iOS reduceMotion guard; Compose tween/spring animations additionally follow the system animation-off setting via the framework. Held at 2 with l1 tension noted: the helper is deliberately duplicated per file rather than shared (ValenceFan.kt:201-204 comment says copied on purpose), the read is remember-cached so a settings change mid-session is missed, and the ungated set includes the Rive vector runtime (RiveLogo.kt:53 autoplay = true, unaffected by animator scale, no static fallback, no pause) plus the celebratory overlays (AchievementMomentOverlay.kt, KarmaEarnedCapsule.kt:108-110). Scored 2 rather than 1 because the gating is visibly intentional in multiple components, not accidental; the gaps are the l2 known-gap pattern.

Strong and partially CI-enforced. All user-facing copy is externalized (rg 'text = "[A-Za-z]' over main hits only the inspection-mode-only RiveLogo.kt:41 placeholder); en/fr key parity plus reference-slug coverage (emotions, domains, categories, domain labels) is asserted by LocalizationParityTest.kt:67-96, which runs in CI on every apps/android change (android.yml testDebugUnitTest); accessibility strings are included in both locales (26 *_a11y each); plurals use <plurals> resources (values/strings.xml:68-84,477-500); per-app language ships via locales_config.xml; server-sourced names resolve through ReferenceStrings with DB-name fallback. Held at 3 not 4: no lint flags user-visible literals, no harness asserts per-locale completeness of server catalog rows from this surface, and a few formatters hardcode English field order for all locales (PebbleReadDateFormat.kt:24 'EEE, MMM d, yyyy', GlyphDetailDrawer.kt:165,243 'MMM yyyy'/'MMM d, yyyy') where WeekHeaderFormatting.kt:46 shows the correct getLocalizedDateTimePattern technique.

Best-in-repo machinery: SWIFT_EMIT_LOC_STRINGS + string-catalog auto-extraction (project.yml:62), CFBundleLocalizations en+fr (Info.plist:37-41), brand terms wrapped in Text(verbatim:), locale-safe formatting throughout (setLocalizedDateFormatFromTemplate in CollectionDetailView.swift:29-33, Date.FormatStyle in WeekHeaderView.swift:71-75; en_US_POSIX only for EXIF wire parsing, ExifCaptureDate.swift:22-28; plural variations and inflect grammar agreement in the catalog), server-sourced catalog content localized by slug with tested fallback (LocalizationTests.swift Pattern C suites assert EN and FR entries for every emotion/domain/category slug), and a catalog-file harness asserting every entry has FR (LocalizationTests.swift:277-310). Not 4: the harness has a demonstrated hole - the guard at LocalizationTests.swift:293 skips entries with no localizations dict, which is exactly the state of 3 untranslated user-facing error strings ('Photo is still uploading.', 'Photo upload failed. Retry or remove it.', 'You must be signed in to save.'), two of which are also raw unlocalized String literals at CreatePebbleSheet.swift:163-174 and EditPebbleSheet.swift:204-218; and no CI runs these tests (iOS has no GitHub workflow per baseline.md; Xcode Cloud config is unverifiable in-repo).

Mechanism is deliberate and near-complete: next-intl with exact key parity verified at the snapshot (829 keys in en.json and fr.json, zero diff via recursive key extraction); 157 files use useTranslations; formatting goes through Intl wrappers (lib/i18n/format.ts: DateTimeFormat, NumberFormat, RelativeTimeFormat, all locale-driven); server catalog labels resolve client-side by slug with DB fallback matching the iOS contract (lib/i18n/useReferenceCatalog.ts); document lang follows the active locale after hydration (LocaleProvider.tsx HtmlLangSync). Known gaps matching l2: user-visible literals remain (components/path/GamificationBlock.tsx:54 'Got it'; components/path/GamificationBlocks.tsx:29 aria-label='Gamification stats'); components/wallet/WalletHistoryItem.tsx:12 calls toLocaleDateString() with no locale so the wallet date ignores the in-app locale choice; app/layout.tsx:76 hardcodes lang='en' at SSR so FR users get an English-declared document until hydration; and nothing detects drift (messages.d.ts types against en.json only, so a key missing from fr.json compiles clean; no CI parity script exists).

The emotion vocabulary itself is neutral and non-clinical in both locales (values/strings.xml:197-243: Anger, Anxiety, Shame, Loneliness presented as plain states, negative and positive treated identically), and no identity input forces a gender anywhere (no gender/pronoun field exists in soul or profile forms). Capped at 1 per the criterion checklist: no written inclusive-language or copy guideline exists in the repo (rg -i 'inclusive|tone of voice|copy guideline' over docs/ finds only the Kritik criteria files themselves), and the French locale defaults to masculine forms addressing the user: values-fr/strings.xml:432 'Te voila connecte avec %1$s', :433 'Tu es deja connecte', :534 'Tu dois etre connecte pour enregistrer'. rg -i over both strings files for ableist idioms (crazy, insane, dumb, fou, dingue, debile) returns nothing.

Substance is largely good: the FR emotion vocabulary uses neutral epicene noun forms throughout (Contentement, Colère, Tristesse... - full xcstrings emotion.* dump reviewed), negative states get the same register as positive ones, no clinical or moralizing labels, no ableist idioms in either locale (regex scan over all 459 catalog entries for crazy/insane/dumb/lame/fou/dingue/debile: zero real hits), and identity inputs force nothing: souls are free-text name + glyph only (Soul.swift:3-13), profiles have no gender/pronoun fields (grep migrations: zero hits). But masculine-default FR copy addressing the user exists ('Tu es déjà connecté avec %@.', 'Te voilà connecté avec %@.' - InviteAcceptSheet.swift:46-47; 'Toi seul peux voir celui-ci.'), and no written inclusive-language or copy guideline exists anywhere in the repo (searched 'inclusive|épicène|écriture inclusive|tone of voice|copy guideline' over docs/ and .claude/ - only the lab-note tone skill and the quality framework's own files hit), which the criterion checklist explicitly caps at level 1; no documented review of the vocabulary catalog exists either.

No written inclusive-copy guideline exists for app copy (searched docs/ and .claude/skills for inclusive/tone/tutoiement; only the lab-note skill's PR-note tone section matches, which is not an app-copy inclusivity guideline), which per the checklist caps the score at 1. Concrete gendered defaults in fr.json confirm the cap is deserved: connections.acceptedToast 'Te voilà connecté avec {name}', record.flow.privacy.secret 'Toi seul peux le voir', and masculine-default participles inside the emotion vocabulary itself (emotion.satisfied.label 'Content d'un résultat', plus 'Déçu', 'Épuisé', 'défaillant', 'déconnecté', 'Comblé', 'Pris au dépourvu', 'Gêné' across emotion.*.label), landing exactly at the user's most vulnerable input moment; the locale also mixes address registers (37 'tu' strings vs 63 'vous' strings). Positives: EN emotion labels are neutral, non-clinical, non-moralizing; no ableist or violent idioms in either locale (rg deny-list clean); no gender or pronoun columns exist in migrations (identity minimization, nothing forces a binary); streak and empty-state copy is invitation-framed with no shame framing ('Fresh week', no missed-day guilt).
